businessModel: Not stated; accounts used for usage analytics
paidNote: Price not stated on Product Hunt; assumed free (unverified)
summary: Native macOS 26+ browser built on system WebKit (app only a few MB). Spaces with separate logins, up to four-pane split view, tab hibernation and opt-in encrypted on-device Memory plus Ask Page via Apple Intelligence.
bestFor: Mac power users wanting lightweight, native browsing
People who want private on-device AI memory

pros.title: Tiny footprint
pros.detail: No bundled engine; the app is a few megabytes and background tabs hibernate.

pros.title: Private Memory
pros.detail: Off by default; encrypted with AES-256-GCM using a device-only Keychain key and skips banking, health and password pages.

pros.title: On-device AI
pros.detail: Ask Page and Memory answers use Apple Intelligence where available.

pros.title: Spaces
pros.detail: Separate tabs, cookies and logins; Split View up to four pages.

cons.title: macOS 26+ only
cons.detail: Mobile and other desktop OSes are not offered (release notes hint at mobile work).

cons.title: Limited extensions
cons.detail: Extensions relying on Chrome-only APIs may not work.

cons.title: Early and single-developer
cons.detail: Version 0.2.x; maker lists "Redent" in one reply, a naming inconsistency.

cons.title: Account required
cons.detail: Login supports analytics; no-login mode only "considered".

faq.a: No, it runs on the system WebKit with a CDP bridge via inspect-webkit.
